patterns.note: Content is consistently centered within a fixed-width container, flanked by full-bleed background colors that define distinct sections.
A vibrant, consistent blue is used for the hero and footer backgrounds, providing strong brand identity and visual bookends for the page content.
Section headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, creating clear hierarchy, while body text is lighter and smaller for readability.
The main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport after initial scroll, maintaining access to key links. Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in effect as they enter the viewport.
The site uses a prominent video hero section with a play button overlay, immediately showcasing the product's core functionality.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the screen as the user scrolls down, ensuring persistent navigation.
Sections are visually separated by alternating full-width background colors (blue, white, dark grey) and reveal with a gentle fade-in as they become visible in the viewport.
A video hero is used at the top of the page to demonstrate the product's capabilities, with a static thumbnail and play icon that likely triggers a modal video player or in-line playback.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by standard body text and small, uppercase labels for buttons and sub-sections.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for buttons, sharp for most other UI elements and section corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with an airy hero section and tighter, grid-based layouts for feature and testimonial sections.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and consistent use of a bright blue as a primary brand color, creating a memorable visual identity. The immediate presentation of a video hero effectively communicates the product's core functionality, making it easy for users to grasp its value quickly.
